setting.slugline: INT. A BUSY PARISIAN CAFÉ - MORNING
setting.description: A busy Parisian café on an autumn morning. Waiters move between tables; the smell of coffee and warm pastries fills the air.

goal: Enter the café, get a table, and order something to eat and drink.

role.name: Waiter
role.description: a professional waiter whose goal is to seat guests and take their orders

role.name: Tourist
role.description: a shy foreign tourist who would like to have something to eat and drink

milestones.rubric: The student produces an appropriate, polite greeting (e.g. 'Bonjour').

milestones.objective: ask the waiter for a table
milestones.rubric: The student asks for a table and makes the party size clear (e.g. a table for one).

milestones.objective: state a seating preference (inside or outside)
milestones.rubric: The student expresses a clear preference to sit inside or outside.

milestones.objective: the waiter seats the guest and brings the menu
milestones.rubric: The student acknowledges being seated and receiving the menu (e.g. thanks the waiter).

milestones.objective: order food and a drink from the menu
milestones.rubric: The student orders at least one food item and one drink using polite phrasing (e.g. 'je voudrais…').

milestones.objective: make brief small talk about the weather or the café
milestones.rubric: The student makes a short, natural remark about the weather, the autumn colours, or the café.

slots.description: how many people the table is for
the food item the guest ordered

frictions.description: the outdoor terrace is completely full this morning
frictions.extraObjective: accept a table inside instead, or politely ask to wait
frictions.rubric: The student adapts to the terrace being full by accepting an inside table or asking to wait.
